Rome does the same in stone: a statement with its author and its year, then a dated restoration. The fountain is the reader's first evidence that facts here come with a source. It is not the Pantheon twice: p65 prints the rotunda's interior through the doors, and this frame shows the fountain base in the square outside, with no part of the temple in it. 9504 px native across 816 px printed is 11.6x.
